# MeedyaDL 1.12.0-alpha.32

Wrapper sign-in gets easier, plus a round of security hardening.

### What's new

- **Sign in to the wrapper right from Settings.** Settings → Advanced → Wrapper now has a
  "Sign in to wrapper" button that walks you through Apple ID sign-in — including two-factor
  codes — without leaving the app, no more running a separate sign-in step in a terminal.
  ([#1029](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/1029))

### What's fixed

- Closed a batch of security issues found during an internal audit, including how MeedyaDL
  handles imported settings files and wrapper sign-in credentials, so a malicious settings
  export or wrapper response can't be used to run unexpected commands or leak your Apple ID
  password. ([#1034](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/1034))
- Release builds no longer ship a built-in browser inspector, closing off a way someone with
  access to your computer could poke at the app's internals.
  ([#1034](https://github.com/MWBMPartners/MeedyaDL/issues/1034))

### Notes

- Sensitive files MeedyaDL writes — cookies, queue, download history, settings — are now
  locked down to your user account only, on systems that support it.
- This is a pre-release on the **alpha** channel — early access to work in progress. The
  in-app updater serves the latest stable unless you've opted into Alpha.
